The '''Dersonn system''' was located in the [[Tammuz sector/Legends|Tammuz sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the terrestrial celestial body [[Dersonn III]].<ref name="KOTOR2" /> By [[3959 BBY]], the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was a part of the "civilized [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]," the territory that had been widely [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" />

At some point by [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="3951 BBY">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' to [[3951 BBY]].</ref> the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]] [[Hanharr]], who had previously been [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] himself and harbored a hatred for other living beings, particularly [[Human/Legends|Humans]], caused the destruction of the population of Dersonn III. He also survived a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] crash there, a fact that was witnessed by the Human [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Mira]].<ref name="KOTOR2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dersonn system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square T-14.<ref name="TEA" />
